ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: How quickly will I see results?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: It depends on the service. Paid ads can generate leads within the first few weeks, while SEO and organic growth build over three to six months. We set clear expectations up front and report on progress every month, so you always know what is working.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What is the minimum monthly investment?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: We work with businesses investing from R10,000 per month and up. We are not the cheapest option, and that is deliberate. Our systems are built for established businesses that treat marketing as an investment in growth, not a cost to minimise.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Do I need to sign a long-term contract?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: No lock-in contracts. We earn your business every month through results, not paperwork. Most clients stay with us for years because the growth system keeps delivering, not because they are tied in.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: How is Marketing Premium Solutions different from a freelancer or a cheaper agency?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Freelancers and budget agencies sell you a task. We build a complete growth system where strategy, website, ads and SEO work together. You get one accountable partner, transparent reporting on revenue, and a team invested in your numbers, not just ticking off deliverables.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Do I keep ownership of my website and ad accounts?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Always. Your website, domain, Google Ads and analytics accounts belong to you, in your name, from day one. We build on assets you own, so you are never held hostage by an agency.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What if I already have a website or running ads?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: That is often the best starting point. We audit what you have, keep what works, and fix what is holding you back. In many cases we improve results significantly without starting from scratch.
